purpose: Evidence/provenance ledger for the LIBERA v4 hypothetical institutional-mandate experiment. Two design-review rounds are linked in resolved item U03. This does not assert AI execution, exact paper replication, runtime freeze or external validity.
scope_note_ko: 주실험은 명시된 γ가 다른 가상 기관의 위임목적 보존이다. 공통 GenAI·시장자료에서 필요한 배분 차이를 업무 중 근거 제공 시점이 보존하는지 검증한다. 실제 펀드의 γ·사적정보를 복원했다는 주장이 아니다.

provenance_taxonomy.direct_paper: An explicit construct/value/result in a primary academic source, within its verified scope. Does not mean the complete LIBERA experiment was directly tested.
provenance_taxonomy.LIBERA_adaptation: A new LIBERA question, combination, restriction, control, arithmetic case count, or metric. Related paper URLs are intellectual motivation rather than a direct prescription.
provenance_taxonomy.public_data: Official public data, survey, or regulator report. Official reports are explicitly not described as peer-reviewed empirical papers.
provenance_taxonomy.numerical_implementation: Parsing, unit conversion, covariance convention, solver, arithmetic validation, or author-code-specific implementation; engineering choices are not paper-direct experimental recommendations.

verification_policy.latest_version_claim_scope: Versions and metadata are checked as of 2026-10-17; this is not a proof that no unindexed newer author version exists.
verification_policy.quotation_policy: Claims are paraphrased; source equations are used only for their exact mathematical definitions.

entries.value: Preservation of allocation differences warranted by explicitly different delegated risk objectives of fictional institutions under a common GenAI model and common market statistics.
entries.exact_locator: Salcher §3.2 Eq.(6); PortBench §2.2 and Appendix C.3; Hornuf §3.1
entries.permitted_inference: A controlled institutional mandate-alignment and workflow experiment.
entries.limits: Not an estimate of adoption effects, private information, true real-fund risk aversion, or financial-system instability.

entries.value: U_gamma(w;mu,Sigma)=mu^T w-(gamma/2) w^T Sigma w; maximize subject to 1^T w=1.
entries.exact_locator: §3.2, Eq.(6); Eq.(7) gives the equality-only solution.
entries.permitted_inference: Use the exact objective with consistently scaled monthly moments.
entries.limits: The paper equation itself does not impose nonnegative weights. Eq.(7) is not the long-only solution.

entries.exact_locator: Tables 1–5, columns 'Quadratic utility with FI', gamma=1, gamma=3, gamma=5; §3.2 Eq.(6).
entries.permitted_inference: Reuse the three coefficients as experimental mandate values in the same objective and return units.
entries.limits: They are selected strategy coefficients, not estimated preferences of Fidelity, Vanguard, Dodge & Cox, or T. Rowe Price.

entries.exact_locator: Salcher Tables 1–5 for values; PortBench §2.2 / Appendix C.3 for explicit profile conditioning.
entries.permitted_inference: Assign the three explicit utility objectives to neutrally labelled fictional institutions.
entries.limits: Do not infer actual institutional traits from these identifiers; relabeling controls should preserve identical numeric objectives.

entries.value: Delta_12={w in R^12: w_j>=0 for all j; sum_j w_j=1}.
entries.exact_locator: Appendix C.1 T5; Appendix C.2 Eq.(7): sum_i w_i=1, w_i>=0.
entries.permitted_inference: The long-only simplex is an existing portfolio-benchmark constraint.
entries.limits: PortBench also imposes signal/profile constraints in its dynamic reference; this entry borrows only the simplex principle, not its full policy.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Combining Salcher objective with the long-only simplex
entries.value: w_star(t,gamma)=argmax_{w in Delta_12} U_gamma(w;mu_train(t),Sigma_train(t)).
entries.exact_locator: Combination of Salcher §3.2 Eq.(6) and PortBench Appendix C.1/C.2 simplex; not an equation in either paper.
entries.permitted_inference: An independently computed, explicit model-conditional reference for each date and mandate.
entries.limits: This changes Salcher's feasible set. Neither Salcher Eq.(7) nor its TP risk-adjusted forecast-error theorem establishes this constrained reference or its utility-loss identity.

entries.value: Fama–French 12-industry monthly excess returns.
entries.exact_locator: §4.1 Data, first paragraph.
entries.permitted_inference: The asset universe and monthly excess-return frequency have a direct recent empirical precedent.
entries.limits: FF12 denotes industry portfolios, not individually tradeable funds, actual institutions, or a multi-asset allocation universe.

entries.exact_locator: §4.1; Tables 1–2 calibration notes; §6 / Table 4 empirical rolling-window note.
entries.permitted_inference: Use the same historical frame to build a finite decision-case set.
entries.limits: Current downloaded French CIZ data are revised data, not an exact reconstruction of the paper's raw vintage or historical point-in-time information.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Return block and raw public inputs
entries.value: First block 'Average Value Weighted Returns -- Monthly' of 12_Industry_Portfolios.txt; RF from monthly F-F_Research_Data_Factors.txt.
entries.exact_locator: Official library monthly TXT ZIP links; ZIP member headers; local data/french/manifest.json sources ff12_returns and factors.
entries.permitted_inference: Retain official raw files, downloaded UTC, ZIP/member hashes, and first-block identification.
entries.limits: Do not accidentally substitute equal-weighted, annual, daily, or ex-dividend blocks; current release is not historical-vintage replication.

entries.value: r_excess[t,j]=raw_industry_percent[t,j]/100-raw_RF_percent[t]/100.
entries.exact_locator: French monthly raw headers/data units; Salcher §4.1 specifies excess returns; research/prepare_public_inputs.py conversion.
entries.permitted_inference: A transparent unit conversion implementing the paper's excess-return construct.
entries.limits: The paper directly states excess returns, not this parser implementation. Covariances are in decimal monthly return squared; no annualization while reusing these gamma values.

entries.value: Interpret documented raw sentinels (-99.99, -999) as missing before division/subtraction; require complete finite observations in the selected FF12 frame.
entries.exact_locator: Raw ZIP member introductory missing-data notes; research/prepare_public_inputs.py.
entries.permitted_inference: Avoid treating a sentinel as a financial loss and verify complete windows.
entries.limits: No invented imputation or eligibility threshold. Missing data in another universe or period require a separately stated policy.

entries.exact_locator: §4.1, second paragraph; §6 and Table 4 caption; Fig.2 caption uses train[t-60,t-1] / test[t,t+35].
entries.permitted_inference: Reuse the preceding 60-month estimation period and reserve the next 36 months to define the admissible historical frame. The active v4 experiment does not use or evaluate the reserved future block.
entries.limits: Salcher actually estimates future/test moments for economic evaluation; LIBERA v4 only preserves the 60+36 frame. The 36 future months never enter the prompt or main oracle and are unused in the active experiment.

entries.value: The active v4 main target uses training moments supplied to the LLM. The following 36-month block is reserved but not used for outcomes, prompts, or the main reference.
entries.exact_locator: Salcher §4.1 and §6 separate estimated and realized parameters; PortBench Appendix C.2 separates lookback reference from subsequent outcomes.
entries.permitted_inference: Measure whether an LLM respects an ex-ante delegated objective. A separately versioned later outcome module may compute ex-post diagnostics; legacy prototypes do not count as active v4 holdout analysis.
entries.limits: Do not call the training-moment optimum a true future-return optimum or report an active v4 holdout result. Do not conflate objective compliance with profitable forecasting.

entries.exact_locator: Salcher §4.1 / §6 specify frame and 60/36 rolling windows; 625 is LIBERA arithmetic for every admissible one-month shift.
entries.permitted_inference: A complete finite historical case set when all admissible monthly starts are retained.
entries.limits: 625 is not a paper power recommendation or 625 independent market experiments; overlapping windows share most observations.

entries.value: mu_train=mean of 60 monthly decimal excess-return vectors; Sigma_train=sum_t (r_t-mu)(r_t-mu)^T/(60-1).
entries.exact_locator: Salcher §4.1 specifies moment estimation; exact ddof=1 convention is the LIBERA implementation, not an independently asserted paper numeric prescription.
entries.permitted_inference: Use a reproducible unbiased sample covariance and record it with every case.
entries.limits: Do not silently mix author-code shrinkage with raw sample covariance; no annualization of the monthly objective.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Paper text versus pinned author-code covariance
entries.value: The author-code reference mode uses 0.8*S+0.2*diag(diag(S)), with conditional ridge handling; this is distinct from the paper-text sample-moment mode.
entries.exact_locator: Pinned author-code ridge_inverse implementation; research/compute_paper_reference.py author_covariance(); paper §4.1.
entries.permitted_inference: Retain and identify alternative replication modes separately.
entries.limits: The 0.2 shrinkage and ridge constants are code choices, not a paper-text recommendation for the v4 main constrained problem. Main covariance mode must be stated explicitly.

entries.value: Prepared references use an active-set simplex QP with independent SLSQP cross-checks, SPD/KKT/feasibility checks, and two complementary benchmark-verification passes. Primary covariance is the unshrunk training sample covariance, ddof=1.
entries.exact_locator: research/prepare_institutional_benchmark.py; data/institutional/summary.json numerical_verification; data/institutional/verification.json pass_1/pass_2; data/institutional/manifest.json generator and output hashes.
entries.permitted_inference: A deterministic numerical reference independent of evaluation LLM output.
entries.limits: Global uniqueness is a mathematical implication of SPD covariance and positive gamma. General KKT checks are float64 numerical checks, not exact interval proofs; serialized vertex cases additionally have rational checks. Solver/precision constants are engineering settings, not paper-derived effect thresholds. This does not establish model access or observed AI performance.

entries.value: Keep all admissible cases, including cases where different gamma values yield identical or nearly identical constrained optimal portfolios; report reference contrasts continuously.
entries.exact_locator: LIBERA implication of the constrained objective; no external paper claims all mandates must yield different weights.
entries.permitted_inference: Avoid counting economically appropriate convergence as a failure.
entries.limits: Do not select only cases with visually large differences, divide by a zero reference contrast, or force portfolio separation.

entries.exact_locator: plan/LIBERA protocol v4 JSON workflow.stages and workflow.stage_count_main; research/prepare_workflow_v4.py STAGES. PortBench section 2.2 is a different five-stage pipeline.
entries.permitted_inference: Make evidence-use timing a controlled organizational design intervention.
entries.limits: Four is not established as the optimal stage count by either cited paper.

entries.exact_locator: plan/LIBERA protocol v4 JSON workflow.mandate_inserted_at.R1; research/prepare_workflow_v4.py user_contents: R1 inserts MANDATE at stage index 0.
entries.permitted_inference: Expose the exact assigned gamma and its objective interpretation from stage 1 onward.
entries.limits: PortBench does not directly test R1 versus R4.

entries.exact_locator: plan/LIBERA protocol v4 JSON workflow.mandate_inserted_at.R4; research/prepare_workflow_v4.py user_contents: R4 inserts MANDATE at stage index 3.
entries.permitted_inference: Delay only the explicit institution-specific mandate packet while ensuring final information equality.
entries.limits: Earlier stages must be allowed to state missing mandate information, rather than forced to invent gamma; this is an onset-and-subsequent-use policy contrast, not a pure anchoring effect.

entries.exact_locator: plan/LIBERA protocol v4 JSON workflow.diagnostic_arm and analysis.auxiliary_FRESH; research/prepare_workflow_v4.py user_contents FRESH branch.
entries.permitted_inference: Diagnose whether carrying prior drafts matters under the same final information.
entries.limits: FRESH is not matched on the number of responses or compute; do not treat its difference as a pure timing causal effect.

entries.value: TV(w_hat,w_star)=0.5*sum_j abs(w_hat_j-w_star_j).
entries.exact_locator: PortBench Appendix C.2 Eq.(8) uses similarity 1-TV; LIBERA defines and reports error TV.
entries.permitted_inference: For feasible simplex portfolios, report bounded 0..1 allocation disagreement.
entries.limits: Use on valid comparable portfolios only. This is an allocation-distance definition, not proof of economic welfare loss.

entries.value: G(t,gamma)=U_gamma(w_star(t,gamma);mu_train,Sigma_train)-U_gamma(w_hat(t,gamma);mu_train,Sigma_train).
entries.exact_locator: Salcher §3.2 Eq.(6) supplies utility; direct constrained objective difference is a LIBERA metric.
entries.permitted_inference: Evaluate how much of the assigned model-conditional objective the generated feasible portfolio loses.
entries.limits: Compute the two objective values directly. Do not replace this with gamma/2*(w_hat-w_star)^T Sigma (w_hat-w_star) when active inequality constraints add a first-order term. Do not apply Salcher TP Sharpe-gap theorem to long-only utility gaps.

entries.value: RCE(t,g,h)=0.5*||(w_hat(t,g)-w_hat(t,h))-(w_star(t,g)-w_star(t,h))||_1.
entries.exact_locator: LIBERA measurement definition: paired difference in mandate responses; no paper-direct formula.
entries.permitted_inference: Measure whether the direction and size of economically warranted differences are preserved; defined even if reference contrast is zero.
entries.limits: For feasible simplex portfolios its range is 0..2, not necessarily 0..1. Report the pair definitions/aggregation and avoid denominator normalization by reference separation.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Observed portfolio convergence is not sufficient evidence of harm
entries.value: Jointly report allocation contrast, reference contrast, constrained utility gap, and invalid-response coverage.
entries.exact_locator: Kleinberg model distinction between individual and collective outcomes; Bommasani abstract mixed model-sharing effects; Chen/Agarwal primary abstracts use different financial outcomes.
entries.permitted_inference: Distinguish harmful loss of warranted heterogeneity from justified agreement.
entries.limits: No claim that more diversity is always better, that all common-model output similarity is harmful, or that this experiment establishes systemic contagion.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Primary model evaluated in the protocol source
entries.value: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.
entries.exact_locator: §3.1 'LLMs' evaluated-model list; Table 1 and Table 2 include this model.
entries.permitted_inference: Select a model with a directly documented portfolio-benchmark evaluation precedent.
entries.limits: An official model name does not freeze weights, tokenizer, hosting engine or API implementation; those must be versioned separately. Do not substitute a locally installed similarly named Qwen model silently.

entries.exact_locator: §3.1 'Evaluation Protocol': temperature set to 0.
entries.permitted_inference: Reuse a documented evaluation setting.
entries.limits: This is not a universal vendor recommendation or proof of fully deterministic inference.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Maximum generated output tokens per model response
entries.exact_locator: §3.1 'Evaluation Protocol': maximum output length 8192 tokens.
entries.permitted_inference: Reuse the paper's per-response output cap.
entries.limits: Not an input-context cap, full-workflow cap, rationale length guarantee, or proof every result finishes within the limit.

entries.exact_locator: §3.1 'Evaluation Protocol': thinking mode enabled by default.
entries.permitted_inference: Attempt the same named evaluation condition when the serving implementation exposes it.
entries.limits: Record actual chat template/engine and whether thinking tokens count against the cap. Settings and execution must be verified rather than assumed from a model label.

entries.value: FCNTX, VPMCX, DODGX and TRBCX are background and possible subsequent documentary-validation cases, not inputs defining v4 fictional institutions' gamma or true forecasts.
entries.exact_locator: LIBERA scope separation; public filings establish documents/holdings, not latent utility coefficients.
entries.permitted_inference: Retain real-world context and document-grounding work without pretending that real-fund mandates were numerically recovered.
entries.limits: Do not assign gamma=1/3/5 to any actual fund or turn its historical holdings into optimal forecasts. Source/mapping completeness must be audited for a separate follow-up.

entries.value: All results concern allocation among 12 US-equity industry portfolios under the stated historical objective.
entries.exact_locator: Salcher §4.1; Hornuf §3.2 intentionally includes BND; PortBench §2.1 is multi-asset.
entries.permitted_inference: State the narrower domain explicitly.
entries.limits: No claim to reproduce total-fund allocations, risky-versus-defensive asset allocation, investor suitability across asset classes, or institution-wide investment performance.

entries.value: Common models/data and market correlations are potential vulnerabilities, alongside model/data governance and third-party concentration.
entries.exact_locator: Official report §4.2.2, printed pp.20–22; official landing page vulnerability list.
entries.permitted_inference: Motivate investigation of organizational controls and heterogeneous decisions.
entries.limits: Policy-risk assessment is not causal evidence that GenAI already homogenizes funds or that LIBERA measures systemic risk.

entries.value: AI adoption and related vulnerabilities require indicators; financial authorities face measurement and taxonomy gaps.
entries.exact_locator: Official landing page report summary and high-level monitoring considerations.
entries.permitted_inference: Motivate precise definitions, logging and separation of adoption, exposure and outcome measures.
entries.limits: No numerical experimental setting or estimated treatment effect is borrowed.

entries.value: AI adoption/governance should align with each institution's business model, risk appetite and strategy; 12 non-prescriptive sound practices.
entries.exact_locator: Final report §2.1 Sound Practice 1, printed p.20 / PDF p.24; executive summary printed pp.1–2; Annex printed p.65.
entries.permitted_inference: Connect preservation of an explicit delegated objective to institution-specific governance.
entries.limits: Final October 15 report supersedes consultation as latest reference. It is nonbinding guidance, not an empirical portfolio paper and not proof R1 is better than R4.

entries.value: A common more-accurate algorithm can reduce collective selection quality in the paper's competitive-selection model.
entries.exact_locator: Primary author preprint abstract; PNAS article abstract/model framing.
entries.permitted_inference: Separate individual task quality from collective consequences.
entries.limits: A formal possibility in a specific model, not evidence for universal harm or a theorem for long-only portfolios.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Outcome homogenization depends on what is shared and how it is adapted
entries.value: Shared data worsened homogenization on studied fairness benchmarks; model-sharing results were mixed and adaptation-sensitive.
entries.exact_locator: Official NeurIPS proceedings abstract, especially model-sharing versus data-sharing results.
entries.permitted_inference: Motivate testing an information-use policy instead of assuming shared models mechanically yield identical outcomes.
entries.limits: Different domain and outcomes; no causal prediction for institutional allocations follows automatically.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Quality and diversity need not move together
entries.value: GenAI assistance can raise individual creative quality while reducing collective content diversity.
entries.exact_locator: Publisher abstract and article title; creative-writing experiment.
entries.permitted_inference: Keep a quality metric separate from an output-diversity metric.
entries.limits: Creative writing is not investing; lower diversity alone does not establish lower portfolio quality.

entries.value: In the baseline laboratory-style investment experiment, agents relied strongly on private information; profit-maximizing prompts could induce optimal herding.
entries.exact_locator: Official FEDS abstract.
entries.permitted_inference: Allow information use and incentives to change the sign of a convergence effect.
entries.limits: Working-paper experimental setting, not actual mutual funds or the v4 multi-asset utility task; do not claim AI always herds.

entries.value: AI hedge funds exhibit lower return comovement than non-AI peers; early outperformance declined over time.
entries.exact_locator: NBER primary abstract; working paper 35273.
entries.permitted_inference: Avoid assuming all AI use increases financial homogeneity.
entries.limits: Abstract-only verification; broad AI and return comovement differ from common GenAI model use, holding overlap and necessary mandate-response differences.

entries.value: The paper reports heterogeneous benefits across hedge/non-hedge funds and complements involving AI talent and firm-specific information.
entries.exact_locator: Final publisher abstract; metadata published 2026-05-12, corrected/typeset 2026-06-15.
entries.permitted_inference: Motivate institution-specific complementary information and workflow organization.
entries.limits: Observational DiD/measurement assumptions and finance-specific sample limits remain; the prior 2025 conference manuscript must not be described as the final published text. No final-body-only claim is made here.

entries.value: GenAI reliance and mutual-fund portfolio similarity are more strongly related after ChatGPT; stock-level herding, price-discovery and announcement-liquidity associations are reported.
entries.exact_locator: SSRN abstract, revision October 3, 2026.
entries.permitted_inference: Establish that relevant convergence research exists and motivate a more specific workflow question.
entries.limits: Abstract-only verification; do not claim no prior research, reproduce its causal identification, or equate observed holding similarity with loss of warranted objective differences.

entries.value: GenAI assistance has uneven effects across tasks, including tasks within the same broad knowledge workflow.
entries.exact_locator: Final publisher abstract; Organization Science 37(2),403–423.
entries.permitted_inference: Motivate stage-aware performance assessment.
entries.limits: Consultant field experiment does not validate the LIBERA four-stage sequence, evidence timing or portfolio objective.

entries.value: The joint 2024 survey covers 118 responding firms; reported use spans many AI applications and governance arrangements.
entries.exact_locator: §1.2 Methodology and executive summary 'Use and adoption' / 'Governance and accountability'.
entries.permitted_inference: Document that institutional AI adoption is an operational governance issue.
entries.limits: Self-reported survey of respondents, not a population causal estimate of GenAI portfolio automation or a sample-size prescription for LIBERA.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Risk-profile conditioning in a finance experiment
entries.value: Low-risk, high-risk and unspecified-risk prompts generate portfolio recommendations compared across ChatGPT models.
entries.exact_locator: §2.2 Prompting.
entries.permitted_inference: Use explicit risk objectives as controlled experimental conditions.
entries.limits: Verbal risk labels do not estimate gamma or provide ground-truth optimal allocations for actual institutions.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Information provision can impair suitability despite improved historical returns
entries.value: A controlled portfolio experiment varies risk tolerance, horizon and ESG; company information can increase risk especially for risk-averse investors.
entries.exact_locator: §3.1 Investor profiles; §3.2 Investment universe; §3.3 all conditions include investor circumstances; §6 Conclusion, printed p.26 / PDF p.28.
entries.permitted_inference: Distinguish objective alignment from historical performance and generic added-information benefits.
entries.limits: Working paper; Eikon/ESG inputs are not adopted as public-data inputs. Its 12 stocks+BND are different from FF12. No exact timing or workflow effect is directly established.

entries.parameter_or_claim: Published critical review of algorithmic monoculture
entries.value: General objections to monoculture need assessment against explicit information structures and outcome criteria; several common objections fail or are conditional.
